title: English Lost 30 Points Of The Early Web
hook: The internet stopped being an English club as the world came online.
closing: Searching only in English now misses a vast share of the web's voices.
question: Which languages do you browse?

segments.say: English fell from 75 to 45 percent of web pages by 2005. The early web's dominance broke quickly.
Arabic online content grew 2,501 percent in a decade. Other languages expanded far faster than English.
English still covers 55 percent of websites. Nearly half the web now uses something else.
